environment.method: min of 5, same process, same warm table (the #664 mutually-anchored-baseline pattern)

write_path.verdict: the partial index touches parent-stamped rows only; the parented rate is inside the unparented noise band (ratio 0.99)

plan_shape.nodes: Aggregate -> Sort -> Bitmap Heap Scan -> Bitmap Index Scan
plan_shape.mutation_check: DROP INDEX => plan re-plans without jobs_parent_pending_idx => the plan pin reds

migration_on_populated_100k_table.locks: ADD COLUMN (nullable, no default): catalog-only, momentary ACCESS EXCLUSIVE; CREATE INDEX: SHARE lock blocking writes for the 61ms build; CONCURRENTLY by hand on large tables (runner wraps files in transactions)

as_of_semantics: snapshot carries as_of (UTC read instant) + cap_age_seconds (monotonic delta, bounded by the 5s TTL; None = no snapshot); depth exact-at-read, advisory after
dangling_parent_pricing: three dangling cases (never-existed / purged / not-yet-inserted) all read as ordinary 'children pending' verdicts; no special-casing, no join; pinned each
retention_linkage: prune candidates are terminal-only => pending children are excluded BY CONSTRUCTION; pinned (sweep runs, children untouched, count unchanged)
